title: Implement export→import round-trip validation test
description: Implement an automated test that exports each round-trip fixture diagram to JSON, re-imports it, and asserts the resulting diagram is identical in structure (tables, columns, types, keys, constraints, indexes, relationships) and layout (x/y/width/height) to the original.
acceptanceCriteria: Test iterates over all round-trip fixture diagrams
For each fixture: serialize → JSON → deserialize → compare structure and layout
Comparison includes table names, columns, data types, primary keys, foreign keys with referential actions, unique constraints, indexes, and canvas positions
Test reports per-fixture pass/fail and overall pass rate
Test runs in Docker (node:20-alpine) via vitest
100% round-trip fidelity required for all fixtures (per PRD success metric)

statusHistory.reason: Ticket created from PRD US-2.3 acceptance criterion (export→import must produce identical diagram)
